hero.subtitle: My House 44 is an elegant and welcoming apartment nestled in the beating heart of Sicily. Comfort, style and authentic Palermitan atmosphere.
gallery.subtitle: Spaces carefully designed to the smallest detail, Mediterranean light and modern comfort in every corner.
space.p1: My House 44 was born from a love of Palermo and an obsession with detail. Every element has been chosen to offer a stay that combines the warmth of home with the comfort of a luxury boutique hotel.
space.p2: Located in the heart of the UNESCO Historic Centre, at Vicolo San Carlo 44, you are a short walk from the Quattro Canti, the Teatro Massimo and all the symbols of authentic Palermo.
amenities.kitchen_desc: Microwave, cookware and everything you need
amenities.parking_desc: Free on street · paid options nearby
faq.a_pets: No, pets of any kind are not allowed inside the apartment.
faq.q_checkin: What are the check-in and check-out times?
faq.a_checkin: Check-in is available from 4:00 PM. Check-out must be completed by 10:00 AM.
faq.a_transport: Yes, we offer airport transfer services on request. Contact us to arrange it.
faq.a_wifi: Yes, the apartment has free and fast Wi-Fi, suitable for remote work as well.
location.p: My House 44 is located in Palermo's UNESCO Historic Centre. Steps away from everything that makes this city unique: the scent of street food, the voices of Ballarò, Arab-Norman art.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions of Use
terms.intro_p1: These Terms and Conditions govern the use of the website myhouse44.com (the "Site") and the relationship between the Host and Users who wish to request information or book a stay at the accommodation known as "My House 44".
terms.intro_p2: Accessing and using the Site implies full and unconditional acceptance of these Terms. Users are invited to read them carefully before submitting any booking request.
terms.s1_note: The CIN is the National Identification Code required under art. 13-ter of Italian Law-Decree 145/2023 (converted into Law 191/2023) for short-term tourist rentals in Italy. This activity is carried out on a non-commercial basis under the applicable Italian regulations on short rentals.
terms.s2_title: Purpose and nature of the service
terms.s2_p1: The Site has an exclusively informational and promotional purpose relating to the My House 44 property. It does not constitute an automated booking, sales or online payment system in any way.
terms.s2_p2: Requests submitted via the contact form, WhatsApp or email constitute non-binding expressions of interest. The accommodation contract is concluded solely upon the express confirmation of the Host or through partner platforms (Booking.com, Airbnb), according to their respective contractual terms.
terms.s3_p1: The User may submit a booking request by filling in the form on the Site, providing: arrival date, departure date, approximate arrival time, number of guests (maximum 3) and the name of the reference person.
terms.s3_p2: After filling in the form the User may choose to send the request via WhatsApp or via email to the Host's address.
terms.s3_p3: Final confirmation of availability, the final price and payment instructions are normally provided by the Host within 24 hours of receipt of the request.
terms.s3_p4: For bookings made through Booking.com or Airbnb, the terms and conditions of those platforms apply in full and shall prevail over these Terms in case of conflict regarding the booking procedure, payment and cancellation.
terms.s4_capacity_body: The property accommodates a maximum of 3 (three) people. Hosting a higher number of people than declared at the time of booking is not permitted.
terms.s4_checkin_body: from 4:00 PM. Different times (flexible check-in) may be agreed with the host prior to arrival.
terms.s4_checkout_body: by 10:00 AM on the day of departure.
terms.s4_rule_pets: no pets of any species are allowed inside the apartment;
terms.s4_rule_smoking: smoking is prohibited inside the apartment and in the common areas of the building;
terms.s4_rule_parties: parties, events or noisy activities that may disturb the neighbourhood are not allowed;
terms.s4_rule_sublet: subletting, transfer to third parties and use of the apartment for purposes other than the tourist stay are prohibited;
terms.s4_rule_quiet: guests must respect quiet hours from 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM, in compliance with building rules and good-neighbour practices.
terms.s4_documents_body: pursuant to art. 109 of the Italian Consolidated Public Safety Act (Royal Decree 773/1931) and subsequent amendments, each adult guest must provide a valid identity document for registration and notification to the public security authorities via the Alloggiati Web portal.
terms.s4_minors_body: minors must always be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian.
terms.s5_body: The tourist tax, a local levy established by the Municipality of Palermo, is not included in the price of the stay. The amount, calculated based on the municipal rates in force and the number of overnight stays, must be paid to the Host at check-in unless it has already been paid through the booking platform (Booking.com / Airbnb).
terms.s6_p1: Stay prices are dynamic and vary based on the period, duration, number of guests and availability. The final price is confirmed by the Host upon booking confirmation and is inclusive of VAT where applicable.
terms.s6_p2: Payment terms depend on the booking channel used:
terms.s6_channel_booking: Booking.com / Airbnb: the payment policies of the respective platforms apply;
terms.s6_channel_direct: Direct booking: payment is made according to the arrangements agreed with the Host (e.g. bank transfer, cash at check-in or other means specified upon confirmation).
terms.s6_p3: As this is a non-commercial tourist rental, no VAT invoice is issued. Upon request by the User at check-out, a non-fiscal receipt may be provided as proof of payment.
terms.s7_p1: For bookings made through Booking.com or Airbnb, the cancellation and modification policies of the respective platforms apply in full.
terms.s7_p2_label: For direct bookings, unless otherwise agreed in writing, the following cancellation policy applies
terms.s7_p2_rule1: cancellation up to 14 days before the arrival date: full refund of any amount paid;
terms.s7_p2_rule2: cancellation between 14 and 7 days before the arrival date: 50% refund of the amount paid;
terms.s7_p2_rule3: cancellation less than 7 days before the arrival date: no refund;
terms.s7_p2_rule4: no-show or early departure: the full agreed amount will be charged.
terms.s7_p3: In the event of force majeure not attributable to the parties (natural disasters, government restrictions, public health events), the parties will cooperate in good faith to reschedule the stay or agree on a fair refund.
terms.s8_p1: The Guest must use the apartment, furnishings and equipment with the diligence of a reasonable person. The Guest is responsible for damage caused to the property, furnishings and equipment during the stay, save for damage arising from normal wear and tear.
terms.s8_p2: The Host reserves the right to request a security deposit (non-interest-bearing) before arrival or at check-in. The deposit, in an amount agreed at the time of booking, will be returned within 7 days of departure, after inspection of the apartment and net of any amounts retained to cover damage or extraordinary consumption.
terms.s8_p3: The Guest undertakes to behave respectfully towards the neighbourhood and to comply with building rules, in particular those relating to quiet hours.
terms.s9_p1: The Host shall not be liable for inconveniences or damage arising from causes not attributable to its own negligence, including by way of example: interruptions of public services (electricity, water, gas, internet), building works, weather events, strikes or orders by authorities.
terms.s9_p2: The Host is not responsible for valuables, money, documents or personal effects left unattended inside the apartment. Guests are advised to safeguard their belongings personally.
terms.s9_p3: The information, images and descriptions on the Site are provided in good faith but do not constitute a binding contractual offer. The Host reserves the right to modify the Site and its contents at any time without prior notice.
terms.s10_p1: The processing of personal data collected through the Site is governed by the Privacy Policy, drafted in compliance with EU Regulation 2016/679 (GDPR) and Italian Legislative Decree 196/2003 as amended.
terms.s10_p2: The data collected via the booking form (name, dates, number of guests, IP address) are used exclusively to manage the request and any subsequent stay. The legal basis is the performance of pre-contractual measures at the data subject's request and the performance of the accommodation contract.
terms.s10_p3: Data relating to reviews published on the Site (name, email, content of the review) are processed with the User's express consent, with email address verification via OTP code. The User may request deletion of their review at any time by contacting the Host.
terms.s11_body: The Site uses technical cookies necessary for its proper functioning. Any third-party cookies (e.g. maps services, social media) are detailed in the Cookie Policy. The User can manage their preferences through the cookie banner when accessing the Site.
terms.s12_body: All contents of the Site — texts, images, photographs, trademarks, logo, graphic design and code — are the property of the Host or used under a valid licence. Reproduction, even partial, modification, distribution or use for commercial purposes without the express written authorisation of the Host is prohibited.

The version in force is the one published on the Site at the date of access, with the date of the last update shown at the bottom. Use of the Site following the publication of changes implies acceptance of the new conditions.

terms.s14_p2: For disputes between the Host and Users qualifying as consumers under Italian Legislative Decree 206/2005 (Consumer Code), the court of the place of residence or domicile of the consumer, if located in Italy, has exclusive jurisdiction.
terms.s14_p3: In all other cases, the Court of :forum has exclusive jurisdiction.
